content.overview: The parties may agree on the language or languages to be used in the arbitral proceedings. Failing agreement, the tribunal determines the language. Unless otherwise specified, that applies to written statements, hearings, awards and other communications. The tribunal may order translation of documentary evidence.
content.glance: Agree the language; else tribunal decides; may order translations of documentary evidence.
content.study: Party agreement on language controls. Failing agreement, the tribunal determines the language or languages. The determination ordinarily covers statements, hearings, awards and communications. The tribunal may order translations of documentary evidence.

sections.heading: Party agreement
sections.body: Parties may agree on the language or languages of the proceedings.

sections.heading: Tribunal determination
sections.body: Failing agreement, the tribunal determines the language.

sections.heading: Scope and translations
sections.body: Applies to statements, hearings, awards and communications unless otherwise specified; tribunal may order translations.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Who decides the language of proceedings?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: The parties by agreement; failing agreement, the arbitral tribunal.

examTips: Party agreement first; then tribunal determination; note translation power.

enhancement.definition: Section 22 governs the language of arbitral proceedings.
